action_items: (Low) Investigate & fix hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — appears on route change (likely inside a Select or option render, possibly a participant switcher). Only a warning; no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: bc2._compute_projection: uses `int(ov.classification) if ov.classification else base_cls` — a valid override of 0 would fall through, but 0 is blocked by Pydantic ge=1, so OK.
bc2 save_scenario: calls _compute_projection which itself re-runs _user_dep + _core1_assert_access; double-work but harmless.
cs1.export_pack_pdf: no rate limit / abuse protection. Given PDFs are cheap and per-user gated by _load_pack_or_404 it's acceptable for v1.

cs1 update_pack: PATCH is not really a partial update — it overwrites every field with the request body (all fields default None/empty from Pydantic). Callers that omit fields will wipe them. Consider using exclude_unset or a partial model.

cs1 handover pack: opt_in_medical strips medical text server-side on both POST and PATCH — good. But on PATCH from a client that didn't send opt_in_medical, the model defaults it to False and will wipe out my_medical_needs unintentionally. Related to the previous point.
BudgetScenarios: dirty/save button gating and multi-checkbox compare all working; consider default-selecting the two most recent scenarios for a nicer UX.
